bow_query.ordering: canonical TimeCamId/score; upstream unordered query order is not claimed
bow_query.temporal_encoding: raw mutual triples are little-endian u32(left,right,hamming); RANSAC ID pairs are little-endian u32 pairs; both are SHA-256 summaries; reject_stage is exact diagnostic classification

unordered_container_gap.hash_bow_bow_vector: HashBow::compute_bow uses std::unordered_map<FeatureHash,double>; fixture sorts entries by numeric hash
unordered_container_gap.mutual_match_iteration: matchFastHelper/matchDescriptors uses std::unordered_map; fixture sorts pair IDs
unordered_container_gap.mapper_image_maps: NfrMapper img_data/feature_corners are unordered/concurrent maps; fixture sorts TimeCamIds
unordered_container_gap.hash_bow_query_iteration: HashBow::querry_database accumulates/traverses unordered maps; fixture retains canonical candidate set sorted by TimeCamId and score

provenance.temporal_ransac_gap: NfrMapper::match_all calls OpenGV CentralRelativePoseSacProblem with its default time(0)+clock() random seed inside a TBB loop; temporal RANSAC inlier IDs/counts are observed-run summaries and are not claimed deterministic. Rust asserts the exact raw mutual SHA, strict RANSAC gate, and reject stage; OpenGV model/inlier parity remains open.
provenance.determinism: Canonical JSON and all unordered outputs are sorted; no upstream source mutation or tuning
provenance.fixture_hash: computed as SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 fixture bytes after writing
